source: Bite's own TikTok listing on bitetoothpastebits.com (product tagged 'TikTok Product', title matches Ralph's word for word except 'Gentle Foam'), images 1-16, fetched 2026-11-03. Ralph sent no photo.
facts: 62 BITS size: small clear round glass bottle, about 2 in tall (reviewer estimate, mygreencloset.com; no maker spec found), about 1.85 times taller than wide, about as tall as a lipstick, fits in the palm with the fingers closed around it
silver brushed-aluminium screw cap with a finely ridged (knurled) edge and a rolled lip, as wide as the bottle

white wrap label in the lower two thirds: black serif 'Bite' with '62 BITS' in typewriter type to its right, a thin rule, 'INSTRUCTIONS' in small caps, typewriter text 'Place one (1) bit in your mouth, bite down, brush with a wet toothbrush - twice a day, every day.', a rule, 'NATURALLY WHITENING TOOTHPASTE BITS', then a solid black band at the bottom of the label; a narrow side panel with tiny ingredient text
the bits: flat round cylinder tablets, off-white to cream-beige with a fine speckle, about one fifth of the bottle's width, about half as thick as wide, visible through the glass above the label
248 BITS size (4 month): a squat wide jar, wider than tall, same cap and label style with '248 BITS'
how to use (listing image 2): chew thoroughly 5-10 seconds, brush with a wet toothbrush; two bits for more foam

claims on the listing images: nano-hydroxyapatite + xylitol (title), naturally whitens, strengthens enamel, fights bad breath, reduces sensitivity, travel-friendly, zero-waste; 1 bottle = 7 travel-sized tubes; 62 = 1 month supply, 248 = 4 months; made in USA (California); plastic-free refillable glass; no harsh chemicals, sulfates, parabens or artificial flavoring; less foam than tubed paste by design (no SLS); B Corp, cruelty free and vegan, woman owned; Shark Tank; 21,000+ five-star reviews
forbid: pill bottle with a child-proof cap
